'''Self-healing metals''' were experimental alloys used in the manufacture of [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms']] [[SD-10 battle droid]]s. The metals were used to construct the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] chassis.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
